notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Coercive Recruiter with haste.
When the Coercive Recruiter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Jaxis.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Coercive Recruiter token, adding {R}.
When the Coercive Recruiter token dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
